reader_map.title: Public project map
reader_map.description: A reader-first map of Dzmitryi Kharlanau's public repositories across enterprise design, transformation assurance, SAP operations, and practical AI.
reader_map.selection: Public, non-archived source repositories returned by GitHub for the account on the observation date, excluding dkharlanau.github.io.

boundaries.classification: This is a reader navigation layer. It does not replace the source of truth, contract, or ownership rules inside any repository.
boundaries.compatibility: Projects can be evaluated independently. Cross-project compatibility is not implied unless a repository documents and tests it.
boundaries.adoption: Public availability is not evidence of external adoption, production suitability, endorsement, or operational approval.
boundaries.freshness: Repository availability and descriptions were observed from public GitHub metadata on the observation date. Follow each repository for current behavior.

homepage.title: Three paths through the repository portfolio.
homepage.lead: The projects are grouped by the decision they help with, so the portfolio stays readable without presenting every repository as an equal starting point.
homepage.entry_detail: Start with enterprise design, transformation assurance, or SAP and practical AI; then open only the supporting repository needed for the next boundary.

tracks.title: Enterprise design
tracks.question: I need to turn enterprise context into an explainable design.
tracks.summary: Use the composer to develop architecture options from explicit context and constraints. Use the workbench when the immediate job is a deterministic, business-readable visual.

tracks.title: Transformation assurance
tracks.question: I need to show what a project claim depends on and what supports it.
tracks.summary: Start with the evidence graph when claims, artifacts, tests, and freshness need to be traced. The supporting repositories isolate one contract, relationship, control, or execution concern at a time.

tracks.title: SAP and practical AI
tracks.question: I need bounded AI patterns for SAP operations or source-backed knowledge.
tracks.summary: Use SAP Agentic Operations for operational architecture, safety, and evaluation patterns. Use Signal to Insight for provenance-aware source processing and cumulative concept memory.

architecture.entry_rule: Start from one user problem; adopting one product does not require adopting the full portfolio.
architecture.source_of_truth_rule: A maintained business semantic has one owning product. Consumers reference it with stable identity and provenance where supported rather than maintaining a second copy.
architecture.projection_rule: Derived artifacts identify their upstream source and remain deterministically regenerable; a projection is not automatically a new source of truth.
architecture.detached_snapshot_rule: A self-contained copied projection is allowed for archive, fixture or handoff use only when its detached lifecycle is explicit.
architecture.graph_rule: There is no universal writable enterprise graph; domain graphs remain bounded and connect through stable external references.
architecture.reference_scheme: eac:// is a logical producer-owned artifact identity, not a network URL or trust assertion; positive assurance requires an explicit verified binding.
architecture.publication_rule: The `page` field is always a currently reachable human entry point. A not-yet-enabled project site is recorded separately as `planned_page` and must not replace `page` until deployment is verified.

products.title: Enterprise Architecture Composer
products.summary: Compose explainable enterprise architecture options from business context and explicit constraints.
products.owns: composed architecture candidates, decision traces, constraint evaluation and alternative comparison

products.title: Process as Code
products.summary: Define business processes as versionable structured files and generate process maps, BPMN, documentation, and test scope.
products.owns: process steps, transitions, roles, gates and process semantics

products.title: Decision Tables as Code
products.summary: Version, validate, compare, visualize, and test enterprise decision tables from spreadsheets or structured files.
products.owns: deterministic facts, rules, precedence and decision traces

products.title: Mapping as Code
products.summary: Maintain enterprise mapping specifications with validation, lineage, change analysis, and generated tests.
products.owns: field and value transformation intent and mapping governance

products.title: Interface as Code
products.summary: Keep interface contracts, mappings, retries, monitoring, ownership, reconciliation, and tests in a versionable specification.
products.owns: interface trigger, transport, ownership, retry, recovery and monitoring semantics

products.title: Data Relationship Map
products.summary: Visualize cross-system business-object relationships, identifiers, dependencies, and broken links from ordinary data exports.
products.owns: record identity, explicit relationship semantics, lineage, observation time and relationship findings derived from supplied exports

products.title: Transformation Graph
products.summary: Build project-scoped transformation graphs across processes, systems, data, interfaces, mappings, tests, and changes.
products.owns: materialized project graph, graph governance and analysis annotations, not upstream process/mapping/interface truth

products.title: Enterprise Change Graph
products.summary: Trace enterprise changes across processes, systems, data, mappings, interfaces, owners, and regression tests.
products.owns: change-specific propagation, inclusion/exclusion explanation, regression scope and release-impact analysis, not a universal enterprise CMDB

products.title: Reconciliation as Code
products.summary: Version deterministic migration reconciliation controls and produce reviewable evidence for file and SQL inputs.
products.owns: reconciliation controls and retained run evidence

products.title: Cutover Graph
products.summary: Model cutover dependencies, waves, blockers, critical paths, controls, and evidence as a versionable graph.
products.owns: cutover tasks, dependencies, timing, checkpoints, contingencies, trusted snapshots and readiness state

products.title: Project Evidence Graph
products.summary: Connect requirements, decisions, mappings, tests, defects, changes, and evidence in a traceable project graph.
products.owns: project assurance relationships, freshness/risk state, bounded evidence packs and historical assurance drift

products.title: SAP Agentic Operations
products.summary: Reference architectures, safety patterns, and evaluations for AI agents around SAP AMS, master data, integrations, and enterprise operations.
products.owns: bounded SAP operational capability and policy contracts

products.title: Visual Workbench
products.summary: Describe processes, handoffs, data flows, plans, and relationships in Markdown, then generate deterministic SVG and HTML views.
products.owns: visual semantic model, view/render configuration and deterministic rendering; imported domain semantics remain upstream

products.title: Signal to Insight
products.summary: Turn sources into evidence-backed understanding with concept memory, provenance, review gates, and visual explainers.
products.owns: source model, Knowledge Delta, evidence boundaries and learning state

products.title: Agent-Ready Web Profile
products.summary: Profile public website interfaces for agents across llms.txt, Agent Skills, WebMCP, MCP, A2A, schemas, and provenance.
products.owns: public interface discovery, resolver observations and intent-specific selection evidence

products.title: AI CV Builder
products.summary: Build portable professional profiles in HTML, JSON, and JSON-LD with a dependency-free reference implementation.
products.owns: profile input model and deterministic HTML, JSON and JSON-LD outputs

products.title: Dkharlanau Datasets
products.summary: Publish citable machine-readable datasets for SAP transformation, enterprise operations, data governance, TRIZ, and agentic AI.
products.owns: dataset records, schemas, release metadata and citable distribution context
